title: Performance
desc: Trends for the host, the Gately process and sites, with alerts through the Notification Center when a metric stays over its threshold
historyHelp: Sampled every 5 seconds; the 1 hour range has one point per minute and the 24 hour range one point per 5 minutes, the dashed line is the peak within each point. History is kept in memory only and starts over after a restart.
sitesHelp: Requests per second, 5xx ratio and latency cover roughly the last 60 seconds. Latency is time to first byte (from request arrival until the response headers are sent), without the response body transfer; WebSocket and other upgraded requests are not counted. Click a site for its 24 hour trends.
durationHelp: The alert is sent only after the condition has held this long; a single drop below the threshold restarts the timer. A recovery notice is sent when the condition clears.
scopeHelp: Leave empty for all sites. Each site (or backend node) is evaluated and alerted on its own.
minRequestsHelp: No evaluation while the last ~60 seconds have fewer requests than this, so one or two errors or slow requests on a quiet site do not trigger an alert.
notifyHelp: Alerts are sent through the Notification Center as the event types "Performance: alert firing" and "Performance: alert recovered"; add a notification rule that subscribes to them. Changing the name, level or remark keeps a running timer; changing the metric, threshold, duration or sites restarts it.
notifyDisabled: The Notification Center module is turned off; alerts are only written to the log on this page.
notifyMissing: No notification rule subscribes to performance alerts yet; alerts are only written to the log on this page.

metrics.site_p95: Site time to first byte P95

metricHelp.host_cpu: Average usage across all cores of the machine.
metricHelp.host_mem: Used memory as a share of physical memory (reclaimable cache not counted).
metricHelp.host_disk: Used share of the partition holding the config directory.
metricHelp.proc_cpu: Share of the whole machine used by the Gately process, measured like host CPU.
metricHelp.proc_rss: Resident memory of the Gately process in MB.
metricHelp.site_active: Requests the site is handling right now, including long-lived connections such as WebSocket.
metricHelp.site_qps: Average requests per second over roughly the last 60 seconds; use "<" to detect traffic that stopped.
metricHelp.site_err5xx: 5xx responses as a percentage of completed responses over roughly the last 60 seconds.
metricHelp.site_p95: Estimated 95th percentile of time to first byte over roughly the last 60 seconds, in milliseconds.
metricHelp.upstream_conns: Connections each backend node is currently serving, evaluated per node.
